listings.title: 2007 Acura Mdx SUV
listings.description:
Selling my 2007 Acura MDX. Yes, it has nearly a quarter of a million miles, but honestly, the way this vehicle drives and handles does not reflect the mileage. It has been my reliable get-to-work vehicle for the past couple of years and has served me well.
**Recent/upgraded items:**
* Newer Michelin tires installed approximately 2 years ago – roughly **2/3 tread remaining**
* Recently replaced both driver and passenger side headlight housings – the original housings had become yellowed and cracked
* Heated front and rear seats – all working
* Rear DVD entertainment system works as it should
* Sunroof operates properly
* Heat and A/C both work great
* Oil pan resealed less than 10k miles ago
* Oxygen Sensors replaced at 240k miles
* Transmission Fluid replaced at 242k miles
* Engine and Cabin Air Filters replaced less than 5k miles ago
* NGK OEM Spark Plugs replaced at 240k
* Driver side tailpipe and muffler replaced at 240k with aftermarket Walker brand
There are some cosmetic/interior imperfections consistent with the age and mileage. The leather on the steering wheel and driver's seat has cracked and split, which is a very common issue with Acuras and Honda's from this era. This is not being represented as a perfect or low-mileage vehicle—I'm just trying to be upfront about its condition. 2 advisory notifications appear when the car starts - one that says "Check DRL" since I replaced with LED and the load isn't registering with the computer. The other is for an airbag sensor issue, which I believe to be rooted in the passenger seat somewhere. All the airbags are intact and have never been deployed to my knowledge and Carfax records.
I really would like to keep it because it has been a good vehicle for me, but unfortunately the fuel economy isn't great for my daily commute. I've been averaging around 15 MPG running premium 91-octane fuel, and I need something more fuel-efficient as a daily driver.
**Carfax is available upon request.**

2013 Honda Odyssey Touring features and upgrades
The 2013 Honda Odyssey Touring serves as a premium high-tier trim, sitting just below the top-of-the-line Touring Elite. It inherits all features from the lower LX, EX, and EX-L trims while adding specific performance, exterior, and technology upgrades.
Top Trims Upgrades (Over EX-L)
Compared to the mid-tier EX-L trim, the Touring package adds several premium mechanical and tech upgrades:
6-Speed Automatic Transmission: Improves fuel economy to 19 city / 28 highway MPG (lower trims use a 5-speed automatic rated at 18 city / 27 highway).
18-Inch Alloy Wheels: Larger aerodynamic wheels replace the standard 17-inch versions.
Front & Rear Parking Sensors: Provides audio alerts for tight parking spots.
Memory Seat & Mirrors: Links the driver's seat position and side mirrors to individual key fobs.
Reverse Tilt-Down Mirrors: Passenger-side mirror automatically tilts down when shifted into reverse to show the curb.
" Full Feature Breakdown
Powertrain & Performance

Automated Entry: Power sliding doors and a power tailgate.
Aero Enhancements: Side mirrors with integrated turn signals and a roof acoustic windshield to reduce cabin noise.
Sunroof: One-touch power moonroof with tilt feature.
Interior & Seating
Seating Capacity: 8-passenger seating configuration.
Upholstery: First- and second-row leather-trimmed seating.
Driver Comfort: 10-way power adjustable driver's seat with power lumbar support.
Climate Control: Tri-zone automatic climate control with second-row controls.
Center Console: Removable front center console with storage and a flip-up trash bag ring.
Technology & Infotainment
Navigation: Voice-activated Honda Satellite-Linked Navigation System with a high-resolution 8-inch screen.
Rear Entertainment: 9-inch drop-down DVD screen with a remote control and wireless headphones.
Premium Audio: 246-watt audio system featuring 7 speakers, a subwoofer, and 2GB of digital audio memory storage.
Connectivity: Bluetooth HandsFreeLink for calling and music streaming, along with a USB audio interface.

listings.title: 2020 Ford Mustang GT Coupe
listings.description:
Rapid Red Metallic! 2 owners, I bought it certified preowned with 21,900 miles 4/2024, it has 37,400 miles now. There should be some transferable warrentee for power train. Always stored under cover in the winter. It is in fantastic shape and needs nothing. The maintenence is up to date which has been synthetic oil changes and a new battery 6 months ago. No disapointments.
- 10 speed auto with paddle shift
- Heated and cooled seats
- Heated Wheel
- Lane departure warning.
- Car cover included
- All programmable dash and LED colors
It has been a great summer car, I'm 62 and have not abused it in any way, never seen a track day. Insurance is not bad, and MPG is ~20 surprisingly good. Clean tiitle and no accidents.
Interior is perfect, back seats are unused because they are unusable for people over ~3 feet tall... under the hood is clean, trunk is amazingly big!
Only reason for sale is want to buy a C7 Corvette just to change things up a little, I love sports cars. This color Rapid Red + PP1 is kind of rare and definately has the look to set it apart, I have not seen another one around Mpls. 
The PP1 cars like this are the ones to get over a normal GT or GT premium: 
 - Performance Wheels & Tires: 19×9" front and 19×9.5" rear Ebony Black-painted aluminum wheels 
255/40R19 (front) and 275/40R19 (rear). Tires are in great shape, about 15K on them.
 - Braking Upgrades: Brembo™ six‑piston front brake calipers with large rotors 
 - Suspension & Chassis: Heavy‑duty front springs, K‑brace (steeda) for improved chassis rigidity, Strut‑tower brace.
 - Cooling: Larger radiator for improved heat dissipation 
 - Aero & Styling: Functional rear spoiler, Larger front lip and side skirts.
 - Interior & Instrumentation: Engine‑spun aluminum instrument panel.
 - Gauge pack: Vacuum and Oil Pressure gage upper center of dash.
 - Heavy duty sway bar
I did 2 modifications: These 2 "bolt ons" are a big improvement for the Coyote Engine that required no change to tune or engine modification and didn't affect warentee - Just help it breath in and flow out better, adding ~15 HP, taking it from 460 to ~475 hp. 
 - Corsa cold air intake. The OEM air box is included. This just flows and sounds better far better for intake. $435
 - Borla 60662 SwitchFire X-Pipe Exhaust Pipe. The OEM H pipe also does not flow smoothly. This thing sounds amazing and should for $600. The active exhaust is all retaind so you can program Quiet, Normal, Sport, Track. The cold start will let the neighbors know when you are going to work! Or you can program it or start quiet in the morning.

listings.title: 2003 MINI Cooper S
listings.description:
2003 Mini Cooper S
Very clean, 38 mpg, COLD A/C, HOT heat, Supercharged with 6 speed manual. Very fun car to drive!
Background on the car- Bought the car from a 45 year old Mini Cooper enthusiast. He was very meticulous and knew absolutely everything about a Mini Cooper a guy could know, and he had a few different Mini's. He did the normal tasteful modifications to the car for a Mini Cooper of its Era as well as maintenance too. Supercharger oil, pulley, Alta tune, Alta air filter, cat back exhuast, Cooling fan relay mod, larger intercooler. I have had zero issues with the car in the last several years ive owned it. My Wife and I just drove it out to Green Bay, WI recently (4.5hr one way; 9hr round trip). Thats how dependable and trustworthy it is... and we have 3 other daily drivers to use. I just drive it and listen to the cool supercharger noises. I dont beat on it, I never race it, I just drive it to commute around (it fits everywhere) and its fun to drive around. 
-Car is equipped with the fuel efficient 1.6L Supercharged 4 cylinder engine. Powerful and peppy powertrain for the car. The car is rated at 38MPG on the highway and around 29MPG in city type driving and it gets at least that if not better. Very smooth and comfortable car with regular maintenance completed. I bought the car about 3 years ago because I've always wanted a Mini, fun to drive, it fits in any parking spot, and the great fuel mileage. Car has mostly been commuted on the freeway and has very well maintained easy highway miles... has roughly 161k miles on it. Has newer brakes, oil change, etc recently done.
-Mechanically the car is great in my opinion considering the age. The engine runs as smooth as a swiss watch and has all of the power that it did like it was new (actually significantly more). Has no issues that would need attention (just drove it 9hrs round trip)!! The transmission shifts perfectly and nice and smooth, clutch is in good shape and it is very easy to drive. The steering is nice and tight and drives straight down the road. The brakes are powerful and responsive (newer). The suspension rides great and is tight and comfortable. Tires are still good, about 70% tread remaining. HOT Heat and COLD A/C!!!!!!
It is a 2003 Mini so with that its not perfect but miniscule such as the parking brake needs to be adjusted, the drivers window needs to be adjusted (I put a window regulator in and I didnt get it adjusted perfect but its very close), could use a valve cover gasket if you wanted but not needed right away. Id drive it to any state in the country today from AZ to FL to NY and not think twice. 
-Car is equipped nicely.... Heated seats (very hot and work great), power windows, power locks, power mirrors, Great Stereo, Navigation that does work, Map lights, rear seats fold down, CRUISE CONTROL, 6 way adjust seat, Lots of storage compartments, remote trunk release, Keyless entry, and much more that im sure im forgetting.
-The interior is in great shape and clean, no major staining. It has the rare and sought after blue leather interior. Nearly no visible signs of any type of wear on the seats, carpet, buttons etc. It really is that nice. the car has been kept perfectly clean and treated with respect. Everything on the interior works... windows, buttons, lights etc, everything.
-The exterior is clean for the year of the vehicle. Paint has a great glossy shine to it. Has no major body damage or major dents. Car was always kept clean on the outside just like it was on the inside and it shows. It does have the typical parking lot door ding and scratch/scuff... you have to look for them but they are there here or there. Minor rust bubble on the rear but nothing major or noticeable. 
Very reliable car that needs nothing but a driver. All maintenance done and is ready to go. We would drive this car across country over and over and not think twice.
Clean and clear title in hand signed and ready to go.

Currently averaging 29-30 mpg. 
It pulls hard to 100mph. 
This is a great car, tons of interior space, is safe and maintained. 
Only way to appreciate it is to try it.

Until it sells, this is still a daily driver. Weekdays it will be in Green Lake; evenings and weekends it is in Omro. 
Call and text is best. If you call, leave a message and I’ll call back as fast as I can.

listings.title: 1976 Triumph TR6 Convertible
listings.description:
Up for your purchase consideration is this very nice 1976 Triumph TR6. After a solid production run spanning from 1969 to 1976, The TR6 met its end road only to be replaced by the Wedgey looks of The TR7/TR8. For many, Triumph ended at The TR6. This was the last model that had body on frame and that Great Sounding Inline 6 cylinder powerplant in the engine room. With an athletic muscular look, The TR6 gained many an admirer over the years and continues to be quite popular today if one wants to experience the joys of Analog British Motoring! Here is your chance to get into a real nice driver quality TR6 and live that experience!
This TR6 has 72,550 miles on it. I am the third owner in its history with the first two, In Family, ownerships spanning a total of 49 years! Over those years, the TR6 received a variety of upkeep maintenance, replacement parts and even a paint job in the 1989-1990 timeframe. Over the years that followed, the TR6 has been maintained to be an acceptable driver quality condition that is clean and tidy but not perfect showing some little dings and scratches and touch ups over the years. Of course as with most advertisements the paint always looks nicer in the pictures and while it's not terrible it's aged a bit with a water spot here and there. Nothing that an all-out paint correction probably couldn't cure. If you are looking for a perfect concours example, then this would not be the one you seek. However, this example of a TR6 is more than presentable for cars and coffee duty and occasional show and where it really shines is just getting in it and driving the Joy from it!
This TR6 starts right up every time. With an initial manual choke adjustment to get things started, things warm up very quickly and settle into a very nice mellow Inline 6cyl tone. The focus on all the improvements and maintenance to this car were done to keep its reliability at a very high level, thus allowing you to enjoy it at any given moment. The following is a list of the improvements.
Drivetrain/Cooling/Electrical:
-Crane XR700 Electronic Ignition
-Distributor Refurbished and Set to "Advance" by British Vacuum Unit. 
-OEM style Stainless Steel dual pipe exhaust system from the manifold back (last few months) very nice system, Sound is Perfect; Sporty, NOT Loud!
-New Carb Choke Cable Assy.
-New Accelerator Pedal Assy Bushing and retainer kit. 
-Long throw clutch slave cylinder. (Uses DOT 5 synthetic fluid as DOES the Braking System!)
-New air filters and oil/filter change
-New oem style radiator, single groove water pump, 180 deg. thermostat, new red 13 blade fan assy. and fiberboard fan shroud kit.
-EGR deleted (have orig parts in a box) 
-New turn signal and flasher relays, reverse light switch, and ALL exterior bulbs/headlamps (Incandescent!)
-New oem HI and LO Horns
Brakes/Suspension/Chassis/Wheels, etc:
-clean driver quality underside. No Rust Through on the floors, rockers or frame. 
-New Brakes (front and rear); pads rotors, calipers, rubber lines, hardware (done in 2018-19)
-New Suspension Bushings, lever shock rebuilds, lowering springs (profile is nice, doesn't look/ride high like it's on stilts!)
-Factory Steel Rims Powdercoated
Interior/Comfort and Function upgrades:
-bauly cars silent door check straps. No more click clack noises when you open and close the doors. Holds steady when open. Really adds a sense of solid quality feel to the doors now!
-Alpine CD/Radio Head Unit with Kenwood Amp. Recent new JBL 6x9 Speakers in a very nice rear package shelf custom speaker box. Sounds Great!
-Replaced orig foam tired steering wheel with a beautiful oem unit. Really stands out!
-New rubber seat bellows installed. Seats themselves are nice and comfortable. Carpet, trim and dash wood is very nice. All dash lights and functions work well.

listings.title: 1966 Ford Mustang GT Fastback
listings.description:
Own a piece of automotive history with this authentic 1966 Ford Mustang GT 2+2 Fastback. A true survivor vehicle, it features its original A-Code 289 CID 4BBL V8 engine paired with a classic 4-speed manual transmission. Carefully maintained within a private collection for over two decades, this vintage muscle car combines incredible originality with reliable performance.
The exterior is dressed in a factory-correct Turquoise Metallic paint finish applied over 20 years ago, highlighting excellent chrome accents, trim, and all-original glass. Inside, the cabin features the iconic original turquoise-and-white Pony Interior, complete with comfortable bucket seats, a full center console, a convenient fold-down rear seat, rally pack gauges, and a factory tachometer. All interior lights and the clock remain fully operational.
Further adding to its charm, this classic fastback includes a Cobra engine dress-up kit, an unmodified trunk and undercarriage, classic rally wheels, and a preserved 1979 Georgia State inspection sticker pointing to its rich Southern heritage. Freshly serviced with a new fuel tank, fresh fluids, a professional tune-up, new tires, and a replacement battery, this vintage Mustang GT Fastback is completely ready to drive, show, and enjoy. listings.title: 1965 Ford Mustang Coupe
listings.description:
1965 Ford Mustang Coupe — the original, and still the best year of them all. This is the car that started it all: a true American classic finished in deep burgundy with a clean black interior, powered by a 289 V8 with an automatic transmission and console shifter. From the wood-grain steering wheel and pony floor mats to the styled steel wheels with red center caps and all that bright chrome, every detail is pure first-generation Mustang — the long hood, the short deck, the lines nobody has ever improved on. Later years got bigger, but the ’65 is the one collectors want and the one everyone pictures when they hear the name Mustang. It turns heads everywhere it goes and sounds exactly like a classic V8 should.

Slip into this black 2004 Ford Mustang Convertible and youre immediately in classic pony-car territory: long hood, confident stance, and the kind of presence that looks right whether its parked at the curb or rolling under the lights. Drop the top, let the stainless steel dual exhaust provide the soundtrack, and enjoy the unmistakable feel of rear-wheel drive fun.Under that GT-style hood sits a 4.6L SOHC 260-hp V8 paired with an automatic transmissionan easygoing combo thats happy cruising through town or stretching its legs on an open on-ramp. The Traction-Loc limited-slip rear differential helps put power down when the road asks for it, while the Quadra-Shock rear setup and modified MacPherson strut front suspension keep things composed and confident. Performance tires and power rack-and-pinion steering add to the connected, classic-Mustang driving feel, and power 4-wheel disc brakes bring reassurance when its time to rein things back in.Inside, the black leather cabin keeps the vibe sporty and upscale. Settle into the power driver seat, wrap your hands around the leather-wrapped tilt wheel, and keep tabs on the action with a full gauge lineup and tach. Comfort and convenience come standard for real-world driving too, with air conditioning, speed control, and handy storage in the center console (plus power points for your essentials). Little toucheslike illuminated visor mirrors, tinted glass, and fog lampsmake it feel ready for evenings out as much as sunny-day drives. And when the weather turns, the rear window defroster has your back.For peace of mind, a CARFAX report is available, and the car includes security help from SecuriLock along with modern safety essentials like front airbags and 3-point belts. If youve been waiting for a black Mustang convertible that blends V8 attitude with everyday comfort, this one is ready to make every trip feel like an event.

listings.title: 2011 Chevrolet Coupe
listings.description:
THIS... is a 2011 Chevrolet Camaro 2SS Coupe, finished in black with a black interior.
A partial list of notable equipment reported by the seller includes the RS Package, a dealer-installed Ground Effects Package, 21-inch wheels, Brembo brakes, and a Boston Acoustics sound system.
Notable modifications reported by the seller include a Roto-Fab air intake system, a Flowmaster axle-back exhaust system, and the front Chevrolet badge removed.
Chevrolet brought the Camaro nameplate back in 2010 after a long hiatus. First shown as a concept in 2006, the fifth-generation model wore a heritage-laced exterior design that borrowed styling cues from the original car but sported modern touches such as an independent rear suspension. It remained a pony car at heart — its main rival was the Ford Mustang, but it was also aimed at Japanese coupes like the Nissan 370Z.
Power comes from an L99 6.2-liter V8, rated at 400 horsepower and 410 lb-ft of torque. Output is sent to the rear wheels via a 6-speed automatic transmission.

listings.title: 2012 Chevrolet Equinox SUV
listings.description:
2012 Chevrolet Equinox LT AWD
Very Clean, All Wheel Drive, Hot Heat, Cold A/C, Newer Brakes!!! Timing chain and balance shaft chain were replaced roughly 20k miles ago.
-It has the 2.4l 4 Cylinder Engine. Powerful and peppy powertrain but gets amazing fuel mileage for the vehicle. The car is rated at 32+MPG on the interstate and around 22MPG in city type driving stop light to stop light type. Car is very reliable and always has been and always had top of the line maintenance. Most all of the miles have been family maintained highway miles... 201k miles. 
-The car is equipped well and has lots of great features. Has power windows, power locks, Stability control, Traction Control, ABS, power side mirrors, Daytime running lights, Keyless entry, Key FOB Remote, AUX input, Auto Headlamps, 6 way adjustable seat, rear seats fold down, CRUISE CONTROL, Hot hot heat (awesome in the winter), cold A/C, map lights, Side curtain airbags, and much more that I am sure I have forgotten. 
-Mechanically the car is as perfect as they get for a car of its model year and mileage in my opinion. The engine runs perfectly and really smooth with all of the power that it should. The automatic transmission shifts perfectly and nice and smooth... so smooth you cant even feel when it shifts. The AWD is awesome in the winter and goes through the snow great. The car needs nothing and is ready to go in my opinion. The car always gets driven anywhere without worry. Suspension is tight and rides great. The steering is tight and responsive and tracks good down the road. Brakes are responsive and powerful... They are newer on the front and rear. No shakes or wobbles and NO check engine lights. Tires are newer about 1.5yr ago and have about 70% remaining. Lots of maintenance over the years and parts replaced or serviced such as rear shocks, spark plugs, brakes all of the way around, consistent oil changes pre 3,000 miles. Timing chain and balance shaft chain replaced roughly >20k miles ago and the catalytic converter replaced about 32k miles ago. 
-The exterior is in good but used condition for its model year. The paint has a very nice glossy shine just like the day it was a brand new car... such a bright shine you could do your hair in the reflection but, its not perfect and has its paint imperfections but very sharp looking. Clean on the exterior and always kept washed and cleaned and it shows. There is the typical scratch, dent, or parking lot door ding here or there like every other car. Always was in a heated garage in the winters and washed several times a week with unlimited car washes at the touchless car wash. Its MN so there is rust on the very lower rockers but its not visible while looking at the car and a spot by the lip of the wheel well of the passenger side rear tire and the drivers fender on the very bottom like every single equinox... passenger fender doesnt have any. Very clean and sharp looking car with a very glossy white color and still looks great. 
-Interior is in GREAT condition... Very clean interior... All the seats, carpets, and trim pieces show little to no wear... No rips, tears, or excessive wear anywhere, the rear seats were almost never even used. Everything in the interior works perfect... all the windows, buttons, lights... everything! No out of the ordinary stains or odd marks anywhere on the interior! Had it cleaned/detailed this week as well as waxed so its looking extra good!
Great car that needs nothing and is ready to go!
No issues, zero issues. Just hop in and go.
Clean and clear title signed and in hand ready to go.

listings.description:
2008 RAM 4500 HD DUALLY AMBULANCE — 6.7L CUMMINS | REBUILT AISIN | KELDERMAN AIR RIDE
CLEAN TITLE IN HAND — NO CHECK ENGINE LIGHT — TURN-KEY & READY TO ROLL
Up for sale is a rock-solid, heavy-duty 2008 Ram 4500 HD Chassis Cab Dually (2WD) equipped with a massive 12'6" x 8' all-aluminum modular ambulance box. Built with the factory Ambulance Prep Package, this truck spent the majority of its service life as a 911 ambulance in Houston, Texas—far away from northern road salt and the Rust Belt—and was later maintained as part of our dedicated special-event medical fleet, seeing way fewer miles per year than a standard 24/7 city ambulance.
Taken out of service Nov 8, 2026. It runs and drives great, has zero warning lights on the dash, shows very well for a 2008, and needs nothing mechanically.
WHY THIS RIG IS A GOLDMINE (4 WAYS TO USE IT):
• ULTIMATE OVERLAND / RV CAMPER BUILD: Pre-insulated all-aluminum box, dual A/C & heat systems, onboard 1000W inverter, shore power hookup, and air-ride suspension. Half the camper build is already done for you.
• HEAVY-DUTY WORK TRUCK / MOBILE WORKSHOP: Lockable exterior compartments (all tied into keyless entry), tons of interior cabinetry/storage, and onboard 110V power for tools.
• TOW RIG / CHASSIS CAB SWAP: Pull the box off and drop a flatbed or hauler bed on it. With the 6.7L Cummins, built Aisin trans, 19.5" commercial wheels, and Kelderman air ride, it's an absolute beast.
• BUILT-IN SCRAP VALUE: If you just want the Ram 4500 chassis, the heavy-gauge box is 100% aluminum, the medical inverter can be scrapped, and there are miles of heavy-gauge copper wiring inside to recoup serious cash back.
========================================
ENGINE, DRIVETRAIN & FRESH MAINTENANCE
========================================
• Engine: 6.7L Cummins Turbo Diesel — 276,000 miles (fires right up, runs strong and smooth, NO check engine light)
• Transmission: Rebuilt Commercial Aisin AS68RC 6-Speed Automatic (Rebuilt at 260k miles in 2018 — full receipts in hand!)
• Drivetrain: 2WD Dual Rear Wheel on 19.5" Commercial Wheels & Tires
• Fresh Maintenance (August 2026):
 - Brand-new Water Pump
 - New Serpentine Belt
 - Complete Coolant System Flush
 - Dual AGM Batteries (installed 2025)
ABOUT THE AISIN AS68RC COMMERCIAL TRANSMISSION:
Unlike standard pickups that came with light-duty transmissions, Ram equipped the 4500 Chassis Cab with the commercial medium-duty Aisin AS68RC 6-speed automatic. Built for continuous heavy hauling (26,000 lb GCWR rated), it features oversized internal gear sets, a multi-disc lock-up converter, its own standalone TCM for aggressive exhaust-brake downshifting, and factory PTO ports.
The original transmission made it to 260,000 miles—definitely serving its purpose—before being professionally rebuilt in 2018 (full receipts in hand). The shop rebuilt it using genuine Aisin clutch packs and addressed the ONLY two known weak spots on these transmissions:
• Upgraded HD Billet Torque Converter
• Upgraded Billet Input Shaft
• Brand-new factory transmission cooler and lines
========================================
RUST-FREE TEXAS HISTORY & CLIMATE
========================================
This truck spent the majority of its service life in the warm, dry climate of Houston, Texas as a 911 unit—meaning no harsh northern winters, no road salt, and no Rust Belt undercarriage rot. Since then, it has been fleet-maintained as a low-annual-mileage special-event medical unit.
========================================
CHASSIS, SUSPENSION & TOWING
========================================
• Kelderman Rear Air Ride System: Includes onboard air tank and ValAir compressor for a smooth ride and effortless load leveling.
